purpose: Teach: イースト/アーチ/大リーグ/サーモン/マイレージ/聖歌/ダイアナ/カッパ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがパン作りでイースト菌を試された
lines.en: You know, dear, back in his younger days, Father experimented with yeast in his bread-making.
lines.style: Slow, low murmur, eyes somewhere far away. Gentle wonder surfacing mid-sentence, unhurried to the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ヨーロッパでアーチ橋を撮影されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, and you, Grandpa — you photographed those arch bridges in Europe when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft agreeing hum first, then a fond, teasing lift on the tag question at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが大リーグのワールドシリーズを観られた
lines.en: Dear, when he was young, Father even watched the World Series — the big leagues, mind you.
lines.style: Quiet pride warming the middle of the line. Measured professor's pace, a small satisfied settle at the close.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、北海道のサーモンを取り寄せされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you used to order salmon all the way from Hokkaido back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, amused opening, savoring the memory of the taste. Gentle rising question, almost coaxing him to remember.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが航空マイレージを毎年使い切られた
lines.en: And dear, every single year, Father would use up all of his airline mileage.
lines.style: Faint chuckle under the opening words. Slow admiring shake-of-the-head energy, trailing into quiet.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、教会の聖歌隊に参加されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you sang in the church choir when you were young, Grandpa, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender, almost singing the line herself. Slow affectionate pace, the tag question soft as a hand on his arm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがダイアナ妃のニュースに心痛められた
lines.en: You remember, dear — the news about Princess Diana truly pained Father, back then.
lines.style: Voice drops lower and slower here. A grave, gentle weight on the final words, nearly a sigh.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、カッパ伝説の研究をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, Grandpa — you did all that research on kappa legends when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Brightening gently after the sad moment, a fond little laugh in the middle. Closing tag warm and settling.
